normal_speed_statement: Normal-speed playback was unavailable and was not watched. These conclusions concern the supplied stills only; motion approval is withheld.
source_composition_pose_assessment: The large right-cropped body and the head's downward, inward progression broadly follow the source. The later source poses turn toward the viewer, but the cartoon face continues to read as a left-facing profile with a projecting triangular snout.
original_doodle_identity_assessment: The angular unfilled body, paired spike ears, scribbled boxed snout, and dangling leg-stroke vocabulary remain recognizable. The long triangular snout extension in the later keys is a conspicuous departure from the original compact snout attached directly beside the head.
most_important_gap: The later head turn becomes an elongated triangular snout extension instead of a turn of the original compact boxed snout; this weakens both the source pose and the doodle identity.
smallest_repair: Remove the triangular snout extension in the turning poses. Keep the original compact scribbled box attached to the cheek, and adjust only its placement and the existing head/ear outline enough to make the three-quarter turn legible.
strengths_not_to_lose: The large body scale and right-edge crop.
The original sparse, angular, unfilled drawing vocabulary and scribbled boxed snout.
The paired pointed ears and simple dangling leg strokes.
The restrained contextual fence and ground lines.
